header.title: Frankencoin|ecosystem
header.subtitle: Services that let you buy, pay with, save or hold ZCHF, grouped by what you want to do.

submit.title: Add a project
submit.text: This list is maintained in the public website repository. Add an entry to src/content/en/ecosystem.json and open a pull request.

useCases.text: For the concrete route through each service, see

tabs.name: Kraken
tabs.description: Buy, sell and trade ZCHF on Kraken, with the option to withdraw to your own wallet.

tabs.name: Mt Pelerin
tabs.description: Buy and sell ZCHF by bank transfer to your own wallet; optional personal IBAN for receiving transfers and paying QR bills.

tabs.name: DFX
tabs.description: Buy and sell ZCHF by bank transfer or card, delivered to MetaMask, Rabby, hardware wallets or any WalletConnect wallet.

tabs.name: Frankencoin App
tabs.description: Self-custody mobile wallet run by DFX: buy ZCHF by bank transfer, send and receive payments.

tabs.name: ether.fi
tabs.description: Spend ZCHF with the ether.fi Visa card. Personal Swiss IBAN for CHF transfers and borrowing against ZCHF, all in one app.

tabs.name: Spar Switzerland
tabs.description: Pay with ZCHF at the checkout of over 100 Spar stores in Switzerland.

tabs.name: PrivCart
tabs.description: Crypto checkout for Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce and custom shops; customers pay in ZCHF.

tabs.name: Ammer.cash
tabs.description: Point-of-sale app and cards for merchants to accept crypto payments, including ZCHF, via QR code or card.

tabs.name: urble
tabs.description: Recurring savings plans in ZCHF or BTC from your own wallet; the ZCHF part earns the protocol savings rate.

tabs.name: Rebind
tabs.description: Savings app with a personal IBAN and ZCHF, EUR and USD strategies.

tabs.name: Morpho
tabs.description: Lend ZCHF for interest or borrow ZCHF against crypto collateral, on Ethereum and Base.

tabs.name: Curve LlamaLend
tabs.description: Borrow crvUSD against savings-vault tokens (svZCHF) in an isolated Ethereum market.

tabs.name: ixEDEL (Sagix Club Edelweiss)
tabs.description: Index fund on Reserve Protocol that holds ZCHF alongside gold, Bitcoin and yield-bearing stablecoins.

tabs.name: Zippy
tabs.description: Mobile wallet with social recovery; send to phone contacts, buy and sell with card or IBAN.

tabs.name: Uniswap
tabs.description: Swap ZCHF against other tokens on Ethereum and the other chains where ZCHF is deployed.

tabs.name: Aktionariat
tabs.description: Tokenized shares of Swiss companies, bought, sold and issued with ZCHF as the settlement currency.

tabs.name: Quitt
tabs.description: Payroll, social insurance and pension administration with wages settled in ZCHF.

tabs.name: Plusplus
tabs.description: Treasury products for companies built on ZCHF, including rental deposits.

tabs.name: Bitcoin Suisse
tabs.description: Custody of ZCHF with a Swiss crypto financial services provider.

tabs.name: Copper
tabs.description: Institutional custody for ZCHF with DeFi access from the custody account.
